550:t_2:59.en:
$$宗介$$
(Is $$アル$$ grieving...? Over $$サックス$$'s death...?)

550:t_2:60.en:
$$アル$$
「At the same time, I am concerned that the low versatility of myself and this unit... and our poor maintenance efficiency may have driven him to his death.」

550:t_2:61.en:
$$アル$$
「That is what I meant when I said it was my fault earlier.」

550:t_2:62.en:
$$宗介$$
($$アル$$'s core unit was built to imitate the human nervous system, or so I've heard, but...)

550:t_2:63.en:
$$宗介$$
(Feeling responsible for $$サックス$$'s death... Hasn't this gone beyond the realm of mere mimicry of emotion?)

550:t_2:64.en:
$$宗介$$
「$$アル$$... It's not your fault. It simply had to be done.」

550:t_2:65.en:
$$宗介$$
「Besides, he said something at the very end.」

550:t_2:66.en:
$$宗介$$
「That he holds a grudge against no one.」

550:t_2:67.en:
$$アル$$
「That is highly valuable information to me.」

550:t_3:4.en:
$$宗介$$
「...What is the meaning of this...?」

550:t_3:5.en:
$$宗介$$
「I've searched everywhere, but there's no $$千鳥$$, and no sign of anything resembling that device...」

550:t_4:4.en:
$$レナード$$
「The ones who stormed $$メリダ島$$ must be stamping their feet in frustration about now.」

550:t_4:5.en:
$$レナード$$
「Even without using $$ＴＡＲＴＡＲＯＳ$$, a transfer of this scale is nothing for me now.」

550:t_4:6.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Why did you choose this point as the base for the $$時空修復$$?」

550:t_4:7.en:
$$レナード$$
「This is a place that holds that kind of meaning.」

550:t_4:8.en:
$$レナード$$
「And I thought that, most likely, only here could we make use of that thing's power.」

550:t_4:10.en:
$$レナード$$
「Getting hold of it took considerable effort. If it hadn't been for him, since he'd kept some influence within the Empire, I think it would have been even harder.」

550:t_4:11.en:
$$かなめ$$
「So the preparations are almost complete.」

550:t_4:12.en:
$$レナード$$
「From here on it's a race against time. We'll begin once the $$ＴＡＲＴＡＲＯＳ$$ control program is finished.」

550:t_4:14.en:
$$レナード$$
「Probably. And once they learn what my plan requires, they'll surely come to stop me.」

550:t_4:15.en:
$$かなめ$$
「How ridiculous... As long as I'm here, everything could be sorted out somehow...」

550:t_4:16.en:
$$レナード$$
「They can't understand that. No... it would be more accurate to say they don't want to.」

550:t_4:17.en:
$$レナード$$
「Soon everything will be ready. That moment will be the beginning of the new world.」

550:t_4:19.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Yes... That is my mission, entrusted to me by $$ソフィア$$...」

550:t_10:3.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Sorry to worry you, $$メリッサ$$.」

550:t_10:4.en:
$$マオ$$
「Yeah, yeah. I'm busy right now, so later.」

550:t_10:5.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Getting all embarrassed, huh... She's so cute.」

550:t_10:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well, you see... Just between us, I eavesdropped on a conversation between $$マオ$$ and $$宗介$$ in the mess hall of the $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$, and...」

550:t_10:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「$$マオ$$... I believe she said what happened with $$クルツ$$ was just a fling...」

550:t_10:11.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Now I've got no choice but to ask $$メリッサ$$ herself!」

550:t_10:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...When $$クルツ$$ covered $$マオ$$ and shot down an enemy, $$マオ$$ produced $$Ｚチップ$$ worth 100 Z. I'll add them to the unit's stock.」

550:t_10:13.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「$$Ｚチップ$$ don't lie... So that was $$マオ$$'s true feeling.」

550:t_10:14.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Welcome back, $$クルツ$$. Allow me to congratulate you on your safe return and on becoming a couple.」

550:t_10:20.en:
$$宗介$$
「Sorry, $$ＡＧ$$. I don't have time to deal with you right now.」

550:t_10:21.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...And here I picked up some interesting data at the $$ＵＮ$$...」

550:t_10:22.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well... I suppose it's fine to wait until this battle is over...」

550:t_10:23.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「A selfish $$時空修復$$ cannot be allowed. I look forward to your best efforts, everyone.」

550:t_10:24.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Now then, as a cheer! Let's get back to work with gusto today... business, business!」

551:t_000:0.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「All units have launched.」

551:t_000:1.en:
$$テッサ$$
「$$メリダ島$$... So we've come back.」

551:t_002:0.en:
$$カレン$$
「Typical of the enemy's home base! They're swarming out!」

551:t_002:1.en:
$$アルト$$
「They've even got $$ネオ・ジオン$$'s underwater mobile suits!」

551:t_002:2.en:
$$桂$$
「$$フル・フロンタル$$ was obsessed with a 'correct world' too, after all.」

551:t_002:3.en:
$$桂$$
「It's quite likely $$アマルガム$$ and $$ネオ・ジオン$$ were connected behind the scenes.」

551:t_002:4.en:
$$スザク$$
「But $$レナード・テスタロッサ$$ and the $$ラムダ・ドライバ$$-equipped unit aren't here.」

551:t_002:5.en:
$$オズマ$$
「That's the kind of man he is. He'll probably time his appearance for maximum effect.」

551:t_002:6.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Fine by me. Then let's clear out his lackeys quickly and invite that smug bastard in.」

551:t_002:7.en:
$$テッサ$$
「$$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$, maximum battle speed to the target point!」

551:t_003:0.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Once this ship reaches this position, we'll launch the $$レーバテイン$$.」

551:t_003:1.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Mobile units, provide support for that.」

551:t_003:2.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「I leave stopping $$千鳥$$ $$カナメ$$ to you, $$相良$$!」

551:t_003:4.en:
$$クロウ$$
「I'm counting on you to support $$宗介$$, $n!」

551:t_003:5.en:
$n
「That's the role $$クルツ$$ entrusted to me!」

551:t_004:0.en:
$$マオ$$
(I'm going, $$クルツ$$...! To disappoint you!)

551:t_005:0.en:
$$テッサ$$
「All units, begin the attack! Break through the units deployed underwater and land on $$メリダ島$$!」

551:t_006:0.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「Reached the target point!」

551:t_006:2.en:
$$サックス$$
「Wait, Captain! The $$レーバテイン$$ won't start up!」

551:t_006:4.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「Captain! A giant AS ahead!」

551:t_007:0.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「The hangar has taken a hit!」

551:t_008:0.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「$$ベヘモス$$ approaching the ship!」

551:t_008:1.en:
$$テッサ$$
「$$相良$$ and the others are ready! There's no need to dive!」
